7. Move `vision/canvas/` + nuclear-shadow **app tree** → `archive/prototypes/` (keep tour **definition** MD/TS if still product-bound)

### Phase C — Preserve SoT (do not prune)
8. Keep: `vision/` identity set, `plans/FEATURES.md` + `TODO.md`, `adr/`, Brand Bible MD/Canon, `API_ROUTES`, `RUNBOOK`, `CONTRIB` (edit), `CONSUMER_DESCRIPTION`, `design/brand-bible` text

### Phase D — Hygiene (post-prune)

**Expected size after Phase A alone:** ~24MB → roughly **~4–6MB**.

## Tag legend (as used)
- **canonical** — current product/design/ops SoT  
- **operational** — how to run/ship  
- **historical** — true-at-the-time, useful for archaeology  
- **speculative** — aspirational / never shipped  
- **duplicate** — same content/apps elsewhere  
- **dead** — wrong paths, unimplemented plans, empty stubs
